resources.string: Access mode and how new apps are handled
Get started: check access and choose how new apps are handled
What should happen when you install an app? You can change this at any time.
Ask me\nYou get a notification after each install and decide for that app.
Gentle\nStandby after 4 hours without use. Never stopped. Alarms and messages can arrive late.
Balanced\nStandby after 1 hour without use, stopped after 6 hours and after a restart of the device. Saves more, but a stopped app cannot notify you until you open it.
Apps that are already installed or already waiting for a decision are not changed here. Recommendations for installed apps appear after a few days of statistics.
